allow: PowerShell(Import-Module ActiveDirectory -ErrorAction Stop; $dc="MDERZADC003.intern.maswer.com"; foreach\($g in @\("MaswES_Projects_Operations_102030105_RW","MaswES_Projects_Operations_102030102_RW"\)\){ $o=Get-ADGroup $g -Server $dc -Properties MemberOf,GroupScope,DistinguishedName; "=== $g  [$\($o.GroupScope\)] ==="; "DN: $\($o.DistinguishedName\)"; "MemberOf:"; if\($o.MemberOf\){ $o.MemberOf | ForEach-Object { "  " + \(\($_ -split ','\)[0] -replace '^CN=',''\) } } else { "  \(ninguno\)" }; "" })

PowerShell(Invoke-Command -ComputerName MDERZFIL001.intern.maswer.com -ScriptBlock { foreach\($p in @\("D:\\Shares\\Maswer\\maswerspainsl\\Projects\\Operations","D:\\Shares\\Maswer\\maswerspainsl\\Projects\\Operations\\102030105"\)\){ "=== $p ==="; \(Get-Acl -LiteralPath $p\).Access | Where-Object { "$\($_.IdentityReference\)" -match 'MaswES' } | Select-Object @{n='Who';e={"$\($_.IdentityReference\)"}},FileSystemRights,IsInherited,InheritanceFlags,PropagationFlags | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 250; "" } })

PowerShell("=== WHOAMI ==="; whoami; "USERDNSDOMAIN: $env:USERDNSDOMAIN"; "COMPUTERNAME: $env:COMPUTERNAME"; "`n=== MODULOS RSAT ==="; Get-Module -ListAvailable ActiveDirectory,GroupPolicy | Select-Object Name,Version | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String; "`n=== DC ALCANZABLE ==="; try { $d = Get-ADDomain -ErrorAction Stop; "Dominio: $\($d.DNSRoot\)"; "PDC: $\($d.PDCEmulator\)"; "DN: $\($d.DistinguishedName\)" } catch { "Get-ADDomain FALLO: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell("=== MODULO GroupPolicy ==="; if \(Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name GroupPolicy\) { "PRESENTE" } else { "AUSENTE - sin cmdlets New-GPO/New-GPLink" }; "gpmc.msc presente: " + \(Test-Path "$env:SystemRoot\\System32\\gpmc.msc"\); "`n=== BUILTIN\\Administrators del DOMINIO \(metodo LDAP correcto\) ==="; try { $g = Get-ADGroup -Identity "CN=Administrators,CN=Builtin,DC=intern,DC=maswer,DC=com" -Properties member -ErrorAction Stop; Get-ADGroupMember -Identity $g -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object SamAccountName,objectClass,distinguishedName | Sort-Object SamAccountName | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String } catch { "FALLO: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell("=== SOY ADMIN LOCAL EN ESTA ESTACION? ==="; $id=[Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent\(\); \(New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal\($id\)\).IsInRole\([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator\); "`n=== WinRM CONTRA LOS DCs \(ahi si hay GPMC\) ==="; foreach \($dc in @\('MDERZADC003','MDERZADC004'\)\) { try { $r = Invoke-Command -ComputerName $dc -ScriptBlock { $gp = [bool]\(Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name GroupPolicy\); "$env:COMPUTERNAME GroupPolicy=$gp" } -ErrorAction Stop; "OK  $r" } catch { "NO  $dc -> $\($_.Exception.Message.Split\([char]10\)[0]\)" } })

PowerShell("=== MIEMBROS DE adm1-Administrators / adm2-Administrators ==="; foreach \($g in @\('adm1-Administrators','adm2-Administrators'\)\) { "--- $g"; try { Get-ADGroupMember -Identity $g -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object SamAccountName,objectClass | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String } catch { "  ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" }; try { \(Get-ADGroup $g -Properties memberOf\).memberOf | ForEach-Object { "  anidado en: $_" } } catch {} })

PowerShell($sb = { $out=@\(\); foreach \($n in @\('LocalAdminRights_adm1','LocalAdminRights_adm2'\)\) { $g = Get-GPO -Name $n; $out += "===== $n | WMIFilter: $\(if\($g.WmiFilter\){$g.WmiFilter.Name}else{'ninguno'}\) | Estado: $\($g.GpoStatus\)"; foreach \($p in \(Get-GPPermission -Name $n -All\)\) { $out += \("   {0,-45} {1}" -f $p.Trustee.Name, $p.Permission\) } }; $out }; Invoke-Command -ComputerName MDERZADC003 -ScriptBlock $sb)

PowerShell("=== MI TOKEN ACTUAL: contiene los grupos adm? ==="; whoami /groups | Select-String -Pattern 'adm1|adm2|Administrators' | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString\(\).Trim\(\) }; "`n=== GRUPO Administradores LOCAL DE MI PROPIA ESTACION ==="; try { Get-LocalGroupMember -Group \(\(Get-LocalGroup -SID 'S-1-5-32-544'\).Name\) -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object Name,PrincipalSource | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String } catch { "ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell("=== ALGUNA GPO DESHABILITA LOS RECURSOS ADMINISTRATIVOS? ==="; $sb = { $hits=@\(\); foreach \($g in \(Get-GPO -All\)\) { try { $r = Get-GPOReport -Guid $g.Id -ReportType Xml -ErrorAction Stop; if \($r -match 'AutoShare|LanmanServer|AutoShareWks|AutoShareServer'\) { $hits += "  $\($g.DisplayName\)" } } catch {} }; if \($hits\) { "GPOs que tocan AutoShare/LanmanServer:"; $hits } else { "Ninguna GPO toca AutoShareWks/AutoShareServer" } }; Invoke-Command -ComputerName MDERZADC003 -ScriptBlock $sb)

PowerShell("=== VERIFICACION DE LA CUENTA ==="; $u = Get-ADUser -Identity Admin2_SLazarte -Properties MemberOf,Description,Enabled,PasswordNeverExpires,UserPrincipalName; "SamAccountName : $\($u.SamAccountName\)"; "DN             : $\($u.DistinguishedName\)"; "UPN            : $\($u.UserPrincipalName\)"; "Habilitada     : $\($u.Enabled\)"; "PwdNeverExp    : $\($u.PasswordNeverExpires\)"; "Grupos         : $\(\($u.MemberOf | ForEach-Object { \($_ -split ','\)[0] -replace 'CN=','' }\) -join ', '\)"; "`n=== CONTROL: NO debe estar en adm1 / Domain Admins / BUILTIN ==="; foreach \($g in @\('adm1-Administrators','Domain Admins','Enterprise Admins'\)\) { $m = \(Get-ADGroupMember -Identity $g | Where-Object { $_.SamAccountName -eq 'Admin2_SLazarte' }\); "  {0,-20} contiene la cuenta: {1}" -f $g, [bool]$m }; $b = Get-ADGroupMember -Identity "CN=Administrators,CN=Builtin,DC=intern,DC=maswer,DC=com" | Where-Object { $_.SamAccountName -eq 'Admin2_SLazarte' }; "  {0,-20} contiene la cuenta: {1}" -f 'BUILTIN\\Administrators', [bool]$b)

PowerShell("=== REPLICACION \(nombres correctos\) ==="; foreach \($dc in @\('MDERZADC003','MDERZADC004','MUSAZDC011','MEUAZDC011'\)\) { try { $null = Get-ADUser -Identity Admin2_SLazarte -Server "$dc.intern.maswer.com" -ErrorAction Stop; $g = Get-ADGroupMember -Identity 'adm2-Administrators' -Server "$dc.intern.maswer.com" | Where-Object { $_.SamAccountName -eq 'Admin2_SLazarte' }; "  {0,-14} cuenta=SI  en adm2-Administrators={1}" -f $dc, [bool]$g } catch { "  {0,-14} PENDIENTE \({1}\)" -f $dc, \($_.Exception.Message -replace "`r`n",' '\).Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(45,\($_.Exception.Message -replace "`r`n",' '\).Length\)\) } })

PowerShell("=== REINTENTO REPLICACION ==="; foreach \($dc in @\('MDERZADC003','MDERZADC004','MUSAZDC011','MEUAZDC011'\)\) { $fqdn = "$dc.intern.maswer.com"; $tcp = Test-NetConnection -ComputerName $fqdn -Port 389 -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; if \(-not $tcp.TcpTestSucceeded\) { "  {0,-14} LDAP 389 NO responde" -f $dc; continue }; try { $null = Get-ADUser -Identity Admin2_SLazarte -Server $fqdn -ErrorAction Stop; $g = @\(Get-ADGroupMember -Identity 'adm2-Administrators' -Server $fqdn -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.SamAccountName -eq 'Admin2_SLazarte' }\); "  {0,-14} cuenta=SI  en adm2-Administrators={1}" -f $dc, \($g.Count -gt 0\) } catch { "  {0,-14} cuenta=NO todavia" -f $dc } })
